dynamicShiftHistory.rule: Only occupied history rows appear. Preserve eight-row newest-first ownership, closing snapshots and targets. Core Float32 arithmetic and UInt32 bucket wrap are finite row-local amendments; no blanket coercion/tolerance.

releaseReport.proposal: Versioned canonical-profile owner supports all 24 Core reasons; released V1 layouts stay unchanged. Publish all 24 slots and clear unused rows.
releaseReport.byteEstimateQualification: Payload-only lower bound: omits string LEN/alignment, report headers, frame copy, other structures and compiled logic; not a Capacity estimate.

declarationWidthFinding.proposal: Canonical V2 generation enforces Core STRING(40) and rejects overflow; no truncation or in-place change to released legacy layouts.

acceptanceScope.shippingCoherence: Per PLC-published row/group and read tier, Part III 3.13; no whole-document coherence requirement or observation-frame client dependency.
